basic_info.description: Step into classic San Francisco' elegance with modern updates in this bright, stylish Cole Valley full floor condominium. Set on tree-lined Parnassus Avenue, this spacious Victorian blends period details with a flexible layout perfect as a 2 bedroom or easily a 3 bedroom/home office for work-from-home, media room or visiting guests. The south-facing living room is full of natural light, with bay windows, a cozy fireplace & vintage moldings. The formal dining room is great for hosting & entertaining family & friends. The updated kitchen features newly installed quartz counters, stainless appliances & a nice breakfast nook for quick bites or weekend brunch.    Two serene bedrooms offer space to recharge, while the refreshed bathroom includes a shower-over-soaking-tub ideal after a run through nearby Golden Gate Park. Enjoy the ease of an in-unit laundry room, extra storage & a shared garden for yoga, reading or relaxing as you barbeque in the sunny backyard.    Leased parking is available nearby, but you're just blocks from UCSF, MUNI, & Cole Valley's best cafes, shops & hangout spots so everything you need is right here. It's more than a home it's your perfect City setup with vintage vibes & modern comfort. Also make a perfect pied--terre!
